name: Naga, Conciliator
body:
Naga, Conciliator

NAGA, CONCILIATOR
CR 8

XP 4,800
NG Large aberration (shapechanger)
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft., greater detect magic; Perception +19; Aura ensorcelled presence 30 ft.

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 12, flat-footed 19 (+3 Dex, +10 natural, –1 size)
hp 93 (11d8+44)
Fort +7, Ref +6, Will +12

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee 2 bites +12 (2d6+5)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 9th; concentration +14)

Constant—greater detect magic
At-will—discern lies (DC 19)

Sorcerer Spells Known (CL 7th; concentration +12)

3rd (5/day)—dispel magic, suggestion (DC 19)
2nd (7/day)—hidden presence (DC 18), status, zone of truth (DC 18)
1st (8/day)—charm person (DC 17), magic aura, silent image (DC 16), unbreakable heart, unseen servant 0 (at will)—arcane mark, create water, daze, ghost sound, prestidigitation, purify food and drink, read magic

STATISTICS

Str 21, Dex 17, Con 19, Int 18, Wis 20, Cha 21
Base Atk +8; CMB +14; CMD 27 (cannot be tripped)
Feats Combat Reflexes, Eschew Materials, Improved Initiative, Lingering Spell, Persistent Spell, Skill Focus (Diplomacy), Spell Focus (enchantment)
Skills Bluff +19, Diplomacy +25, Knowledge (arcana) +15, Knowledge (history) +18, Perception +19, Sense Motive +19, Spellcraft +18, Use Magic Device +19
Languages Draconic, Aklo, Celestial, Common, Infernal
SQ change shape (any humanoid or monstrous humanoid; alter self or monstrous physique IUM), keen spellsight, multiplicity, skilled negotiator

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Ensorcelled Presence (Su)

A conciliator naga’s magical abilities cause spells to become more persistent in its presence. All spells cast within 30 feet of a conciliator naga (including its own) are affected as per the Extend

Spell feat.

Keen Spellsight (Su)

Whenever a creature is within the effects of a conciliator naga’s greater detect magic, the conciliator naga immediately becomes aware of all spell effects currently affecting the creature.

Multiplicity (Su)

While under the effects of change shape, the two-headed conciliator naga is capable of splitting into two separate creatures as per the bilocation spell. The two forms of the conciliator naga need not be identical or even similar (one, for example, could be a serpentfolk while the other is an elf).

Skilled Negotiator (Ex)

A conciliator naga treats all Charisma-based skills as class skills.

Spell Casting

A conciliator naga casts spells as a 7th-level sorcerer.

ABOUT

The twin heads of a conciliator naga offer disparate perspectives on every situation, amplifying the diplomatic and analytical skills honed over repeated reincarnations. Though endowed with the strength and sorcery of their fellows, conciliator naga prefer to resolve matters bloodlessly and justly, weighing the needs and desires of all involved in thorough evaluation.
